blocks.text: Proposition aisa statement hai jo ya sach ho ya jhoot. Woh ek hi waqt mein sach aur jhoot dono nahi ho sakta. Sawal (questions) aur hukm (commands) propositions nahi hote. Maslan “Sooraj mashriq (east) se nikalta hai” ek proposition hai. Proposition ka matlab saaf hona chahiye, uljhan wala nahi. Propositions logic ki bunyadi units (sab se chhote hisse) hain. Inhi se logical expressions bante hain. Logic mein propositions ko samajhna zaroori hai. Proposition ko aam taur par bare harf (capital letter) se likhte hain, jaise P, Q ya R. Maslan agar P statement “The sky is blue” (aasman neela hai) ko dikhaye, to hum likhte hain:

blocks.prompt: In mein se kaun se propositions hain? (a) Lahore Punjab mein hai. (b) Apni kitab kholo. (c) 7 even (juft) number hai.
blocks.explanation: (a) aur (c) propositions hain: (a) sach hai aur (c) jhoot, lekin dono ki ek pakki value hai. (b) hukm (command) hai, is liye proposition nahi.

items: Proposition: aisa statement jo sach ya jhoot ho, dono kabhi nahi.
Sawal aur hukm propositions nahi hote; naam bare harf P, Q, R se.
